risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and quantitatively supported, particularly regarding allowances, contract revenue, debt, liquidity facilities, and covenant compliance. Key risks include substantial leverage, estimation uncertainty in receivables, inventory, taxes, warranty obligations, percentage-of-completion accounting, and goodwill impairment, as well as restricted access to foreign cash. The tone is broadly stable but moderately qualified due to extensive forward-looking assumptions and reliance on management judgments.
